_about.side: orthographic, camera pitched down 11 deg looking +y, sun from behind-left of the camera (elev 50 deg); side_base_px = trunk base (ground contact) pixel, x right / y down, pixel-centre convention: pixel (i,j) spans [i,i+1)
_about.top: orthographic straight down, image up = north (+y), sun from north-west (elev 50 deg); top_trunk_px = trunk centre pixel
_about.topshadow: L 0..255 = shadow strength on the ground; may be larger than 96x96 (extends right/down only), same origin and px/m as the top view
_about.alpha: straight (unassociated) alpha; transparent pixels carry the nearest edge colour
_about.units: metres; px_per_m lets the engine scale by the real size

tree_oak.topshadow_origin: same top-left pixel and scale as the top view

tree_pine.topshadow_origin: same top-left pixel and scale as the top view

tree_poplar.topshadow_origin: same top-left pixel and scale as the top view

tree_palm.topshadow_origin: same top-left pixel and scale as the top view

bush.topshadow_origin: same top-left pixel and scale as the top view

flag.note: base = bottom of the pin (hole centre); wind towards +x (screen right)
